many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

4|def transform(grid):
5|    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
6|    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
7|    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
8|    rectangles = []
9|    for r in range(h):
10|        for c in range(w):
11|            color = grid[r][c]
12|            if color == background or seen[r][c]:
13|                continue
14|            q = deque([(r, c)])
15|            seen[r][c] = True
16|            cells = []
17|            while q:
18|                y, x = q.popleft()
19|                cells.append((y, x))
20|                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
21|                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
22|                        if dy == dx == 0:
23|                            continue
24|                        ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
25|                        if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == color:
26|                            seen[ny][nx] = True
27|                            q.append((ny, nx))
28|            r0 = min(y for y, _ in cells)
29|            r1 = max(y for y, _ in cells)
30|            c0 = min(x for _, x in cells)
31|            c1 = max(x for _, x in cells)
32|            area = (r1 - r0 + 1) * (c1 - c0 + 1)
33|            # Keep dense, two-dimensional colored rectangles; scattered marks are noise.
